summary: Database security events are now kept in your own Log Analytics workspace, and the nightly update recovers from short network faults.

new.title: Database security events are recorded
new.text: PIM Manager's database now records security events, such as sign-ins and permission changes, in your own Log Analytics workspace for 90 days. New and existing installations get it.

new.title: About card on the Support page
new.text: The Support page now has an About card with the Invardia legal line.

fixes.title: Tier impact report shows level separately
fixes.text: The Tier impact report takes the tier from the tier marker and shows the level in its own column.

fixes.title: Nightly update recovers from network faults
fixes.text: A nightly update that hits a short network fault while storing the new version retries once. A second failure is reported in plain words.
